name: Estate Protocol
description: Estate protocol offers investors access to fractional ownership of real estate in the most sought-after markets in the world with secure, globally recognized asset protection. Estate Protocol enables cross-border investments with minimal barriers, allowing anyone to invest in high-quality real estate with as little as $50.
methodology: TVL for Estate Protocol consists of the accumulation of all properties prices, each being tokenSupply * tokenPrice where tokenPrice is given by the API
